objective.baseline: same command and ordinary balance state with one named support or tracking defect changed
objective.horizon: per-control-step Reward; discounted return semantics remain owned by SAC gamma
objective.evidence_scope: executed raw simulator outcome fields at the current control step

relations.condition: command is exactly zero and all other observed fields match
relations.left: upright supported stand with base centered over the two feet
relations.right: rear-shifted base outside the intended feet-center alignment

relations.condition: command is exactly zero and all other observed fields match
relations.left: supported stand with nominal foot yaw
relations.right: toe-in stand with nonzero foot-yaw error

relations.condition: command is exactly zero and all other observed fields match
relations.left: high supported stand with both feet in balanced contact

relations.condition: command is nonzero and ordinary balance fields match
relations.left: base linear and yaw velocity track the command
relations.right: base velocity fails to track the same command

cannot_be_offset_by: walking tracking credit under a zero command
standing support geometry credit under a nonzero command
gait phase, footfall phase, action magnitude, or rigid default-pose credit

incomparable_cases.reason: They satisfy different command-conditioned objectives; no total cross-command preference is defined.
